plugin.name: posterchan-shell
plugin._long: Disable interactive movement and resize only for registered desktop surfaces, and optionally keep the mouse pointer on the monitor a fullscreen window is using.

option.name: confine_pointer_to_fullscreen
option._short: Keep the pointer on a fullscreen window's monitor
option._long: While a fullscreen window is focused, the pointer cannot leave the monitor it is on. ON by default: a cursor sliding off a fullscreen game onto a second monitor is the failure, and no other desktop asks first. Turn it off in System Settings -> Displays, or with `pc-pointer-confine off`. A client that takes a pointer-constraints-v1 grab of its own is left alone, and a single-monitor machine is never affected.

option.name: window_border
option._short: Draw an accent border around every application window
option._long: A ring around each native window, drawn by the compositor whether the application decorates itself (Firefox, GTK) or Wayfire does (foot, Qt), so every window on the desktop carries the same frame as a PosterChan window. PosterChan's own windows draw theirs and are skipped, as is anything fullscreen.

option.name: window_border_size
option._long: Pixels. Keep equal to [decoration] border_size, so on a Wayfire-decorated window the ring covers the decoration's own border band and leaves its title bar alone.

option.name: window_border_radius
option._long: Pixels. Keep equal to the `.osw` border-radius in static/css/client.css: a native app window and a PosterChan window sit on the same desktop, and one square corner beside a round one reads as two desktops. 0 draws the old square ring.

option.name: window_border_active_color
option._long: The client's accent at the opacity #pc-oswin-frame.focused draws it, over the desktop colour.

option.name: window_border_inactive_color
option._long: The client's accent at the opacity #pc-oswin-frame draws an unfocused frame, over the desktop colour.
